# Gramlot examples 0.3.23

The gallery Code editor now fills the available panel height. Layout space is
assigned to its Labelbox, with a 3 px inset, instead of leaving CodeMirror at
its default 300 px height.

Verified on Chromium and WebKit across desktop/mobile viewport sizes, tab
switching, detachment and reattachment. Editor identity and content are retained.
Remote editing remains disabled on the public galleries.
